title: Yesterday, Today, Tomorrow
label: ch:ml-days
canDo: I can say which day something happened on or will happen on.

payoff.summary: From cold: the three day words, the three verb endings they travel with, and the observation that one of the three was already owned but locked inside a farewell.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. Only TWO words are new: naale is taught as a RELEASE rather than an introduction, because it is used in five earlier lessons and owned by none of them -- claiming it as a headword would convert that invisible debt into five forward references, so the third lesson is a grammar lesson about the word leaving the farewell, not a vocabulary lesson about the word.
